kpi_name: Patients experiencing barriers to healthcare access
impact_mechanism: Poor access may reduce preventive and scheduled service utilization while increasing delayed or acute care use.
decision_use: Assess whether access investments change utilization patterns and service demand.

impact_mechanism: Behavioral-health capacity constraints may increase emergency utilization, staffing burden, and avoidable high-cost care.
decision_use: Estimate financial benefit of behavioral-health capacity expansion or integrated care.

impact_mechanism: Substance-use burden can increase treatment cost and community-health investment requirements.
decision_use: Evaluate prevention and treatment interventions against program cost and avoided utilization.

impact_mechanism: Health disparities may affect service access, uncompensated care, utilization, and targeted community investment.
decision_use: Prioritize equity interventions based on population impact and financial consequences.

impact_mechanism: Large bond financing affects debt service, liquidity, and capacity for additional capital investment.
decision_use: Assess available capital and trade-offs among infrastructure, resilience, and sustainability investments.

impact_mechanism: Additional taxable financing affects leverage, interest expense, and overall financing cost.
decision_use: Evaluate financing mix and implications for future capital projects.
